scope: Bounded FIN06 FIN07 FIN08 FIN10 application fixes
status: Implemented and focused verification passed; root integration and independent/qualified release review outstanding
invariants: Only a partner-owned active/open approved station may use a wallet authorization code; status is locked through the sale transaction.
Rejected station leaves wallet balance, wallet ledger, card code expiry and counters, transactions, and fueling logs unchanged.
A committed sale records its original authoritative published quote in unit_price_kobo; later station price updates cannot change it.
Historical savings are exact integer sum of each positive recorded base_amount_kobo minus charged amount_kobo, bounded by customer, successful status, and optional date.
Missing historical base evidence is excluded; no synthetic old station prices or current market estimate is presented as historical savings.
A payment plan catalogue is only cached after a complete valid documented v3 envelope with all bounded pages; malformed, throttled and over-limit outcomes stay stale.

limitations: Legacy transaction unit_price_kobo was migration-backfilled from charged amount per litre; new unit_price_kobo is the immutable original quote, and historical savings deliberately uses actual recorded base/amount totals rather than relying on mixed old unit-price semantics.
Legacy rows without base_amount_kobo cannot prove discounts and are excluded; no production records were changed.
Existing fuel price x litres and discount pricing arithmetic remain broader FIN12 precision work; this increment changes historical monetary aggregation, not all money arithmetic.
Live Flutterwave sandbox/staging, provider statement reconciliation, financial architecture/custody review and complete production release checks remain outside this local proof.
